name: application-crop-growth-timeline
title: Crop Growth Timeline
description: A planting-to-harvest stage tracker with dated milestones, a progress connector, and current weather/growing-degree-day context.
useWhen: Agriculture dashboards need to show where a specific crop/field is in its lifecycle, from seeding through harvest.
The stage sequence is fixed and known in advance (e.g. seeded, sprouted, vegetative, flowering, harvest), unlike freeform event logs.
avoidWhen: Tracking a chronological log of discrete, varied events with notes and providers — `Care Timeline`'s avatar-led event list fits that shape better.
The crop's stage count or order varies per instance — a fixed horizontal stepper assumes a known, linear sequence.
responsiveBehavior: The stage stepper stays horizontal with stages spaced evenly via flex justify-between; labels wrap to two lines under each stage marker at narrow widths.
accessibility: The current stage carries aria-current="true" in addition to its ring highlight, and completed stages show a checkmark icon rather than relying on color alone.
Each stage's name and date range are rendered as visible text beneath its marker, not conveyed only through position on the connector.
The weather/growing-degree-day summary and next-action text are plain text, readable independent of the stepper's visual layout.

variants.title: Sweet corn growth stages
variants.description: A five-stage sweet corn timeline (Seeded, Sprouted, Vegetative, Flowering, Harvest) with two completed stages, the current stage highlighted with a ring, a day-count badge, and a weather/growing-degree-day summary bar with a next-action note.
accessibility: The current stage carries aria-current="true"; completed stages show a checkmark icon.

variants.title: Sweet corn growth stages (Dark)
variants.description: Crop growth timeline adapted for dark surfaces, including the progress connector and current-stage ring highlight.
accessibility: Stage labels, dates, and the weather summary all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark card background.
